biggest_catch: The $250 adult bonus is deposited into a LOCKED 7-month CD — no early withdrawal permitted, and closing your account early forfeits the reward and earnings. Also the offer excludes anyone who was a member within the last 12 months, and all four actions (checking/debit card, eStatements, Savvy Money) must be completed within 2 weeks of opening.
catches: Adult 18+: $250 reward deposited into a locked 7-month CD — no early withdrawal permitted; closing the account early forfeits the $250 reward and earnings.
All qualification actions (checking + debit card, eStatements, Savvy Money enrollment) must be completed within 2 weeks of opening the account.
Youth (13-17) $100 reward available after 30 days; youth account requires adult joint owner 18+.
Not available to current or previous members who were members within the last 12 months.
Consumer accounts only; one tier only (adult or youth) — not both.
Youth CD option has an early withdrawal penalty; if the youth bonus is not taken as a CD, the $100 goes to the primary share with no strings attached.
Rewards are dividends and will be reported to the IRS on Form 1099-INT.
Terms valid as of 4/1/2026; no fixed expiration date shown on the official page.

steps: Open a new AAACU membership online or at a branch (must not have been a member within the prior 12 months).
Open a checking account with a debit card.
Enroll in Savvy Money. Complete all four items within 2 weeks of account opening.

Adults 18+ receive the $250 reward deposited into a locked 7-month CD (no early withdrawal; early closure forfeits the reward and earnings); youth 13-17 with an adult joint owner receive the $100 reward available 30 days after opening. Rewards are reported as dividends on Form 1099-INT.
timing: Adult: $250 locked in a 7-month CD (available at maturity; early closure forfeits). Youth: $100 available 30 days after account opening.
when_cash_arrives: Bonus $100–$250. Per official terms: Adult: $250 locked in a 7-month CD (available at maturity; early closure forfeits). Youth: $100 available 30 days after account opening. Earliest realistic: 7 months (CD maturity — the reward is not liquid cash until then).
maximize: Fastest honest path. There is no fast path to liquid cash: the reward is deposited into a locked certificate of deposit that only releases at maturity, and early closure forfeits it.
